description: Bounded exact-rate traces for the source's RoundRobin, GlobalMin, LocalMin, and Linear schedulers.

source.title: Schedulers for Optimistic Rate Based Flow Control
source.reference: Encyclopedia of Algorithms, DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-2864-4_356; summarizes Fatourou, Mavronicolas, and Spirakis (2005)
source.algorithm_attribution: Optimistic rate update with RoundRobin, GlobalMin, LocalMin, and Linear session selection
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded profile; no book prose or source code copied

input.encoding: [session_count, link_count, scheduler_mode, update_count, link_capacities[links], session_link_incidence[sessions][links] row-major]
input.path_rule: Each session traverses at least one supplied link.
input.initial_rates: All session rates start at zero.

output.encoding: For each session in ID order, a reduced nonnegative rate numerator followed by its positive denominator.

workspace.meaning: Bounded session-link incidence, exact common-denominator rates, per-link update water levels, and staged rational output.

contract.update_rule: For each link of the updated session, find the largest x satisfying x + sum(min(rate[j], x)) <= link_capacity for the other sessions on that link. Apply the minimum candidate across the updated session's links; on the limiting link, reduce other rates above x to x. All rates remain within link capacities.
contract.roundrobin_rule: Select session IDs in repeated ascending order.
contract.globalmin_rule: Select minimum current rate, tie by lower session ID.
contract.localmin_rule: Select the lowest-ID session whose rate and ID are lexicographically no greater than every session sharing one of its links.
contract.linear_rule: Select a session on a maximum-utilization nonempty link; utilization ties use lower link ID and session ties use lower session ID.
contract.trace_rule: Perform exactly the supplied number of update operations; this bounded result does not assert convergence.
